file_stem: RWB TE 006 Outbox and retry for outbound work
title: Outbox and retry for outbound work
goal: Events and outbound work are written in the same transaction as the change, then delivered in order with retry
why: Nothing is lost and nothing is sent for a change that rolled back. Every event EV-01..EV-28 and every WIN dispatch goes through this one outbox.
ace_note: No ACE read. The outbox is Workbench plumbing; consumers include win-dispatch, the ledger and reporting.

writes.note: event + case_seq, same transaction as the change
one per consumer: PENDING, DELIVERED, EXCEPTION

stores: Consumer idempotency store (IdempotencyGuard, E1-007); ACE audit log on resend; operations alert channel

path.text: JOB-11 picks lowest seq per case

rules: BR1: the event and the change commit in the same transaction
BR4: per-case order is kept for each consumer
BR5: retry, then the exception queue with a task
BR8: no decision log entry, no move to exception
risks: Resend of a delivery not in EXCEPTION -> 409 (MSG-P2-022)
Case-less event over the limit -> EXCEPTION + alert (MSG-P2-001)
Decision log unwritable at the limit -> stays RETRYING (MSG-P7-003)
example: Notice NT-SYN-0601 on RW-2026-000601 approved, commit at 2026-12-14 10:00:00
-> one WIN_DISPATCH event, one delivery for consumer 'win-dispatch'
Retries at 1, 5 and 15 minutes if WIN does not answer
